tasks.label: Run Tests
tasks.command: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml --env-file config/.env.dev run --rm etl-pipeline pytest -q

tasks.label: Run ETL with Debug
tasks.command: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml --env-file config/.env.dev run --rm --service-ports etl-pipeline python -Xfrozen_modules=off -m debugpy --listen 0.0.0.0:5678 --wait-for-client -m durin

tasks.label: Run Tests with Debug
tasks.command: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml --env-file config/.env.dev run --rm --service-ports etl-pipeline python -Xfrozen_modules=off -m debugpy --listen 0.0.0.0:5678 --wait-for-client -m pytest -o log_cli=true -o log_cli_level=DEBUG -q
